messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: HIGH - rate-limiter-service returning increased 429s across multiple regions. Impact: ~5% of requests failing, elevated latency for burst traffic. PD: https://pagerduty/redwood/INC-98765 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-98765 assigned to lee (oncall) — please acknowledge.
lee (oncall): acked. I'm on it, heading in. any quick context?
sam (support): customer reports of timeouts and repeated throttles, most reports from EU region. A few high-traffic tenants (acme, beta-shop) are affected.
maria (sre): seeing 429 spike graph on Datadog: limiter error rate up x10 in eu-west-1 since ~10:12UTC. CPU on limiter pods low, but errors are 429 responses from limiter itself (not upstream).
derek (platform): checking limiter control-plane - my view shows the quota-mapper agent returning stale configs for several tenants. There's an error in config sync: last successful sync 10:09UTC, subsequent syncs failing with 502 from config-service.
lee (oncall): thanks. can we route around config-service or use cached policy? runbook says fallback to permissive mode.
maria (sre): runbook excerpt -> permissive mode disables tenant-level enforcement and relies on global ratecap. steps: 1) flip feature flag in limiter to permissive 2) restart one pod to pick up flag 3) monitor 429s.
lee (oncall): doing step 1. toggling feature flag for limiter via admin API now.
lee (oncall): POST /admin/flags/limiter/permissive 
lee (oncall): payload: {"permissive": true, "reason":"INC-98765 config-sync-failure"}
ops-bot: Command accepted. Flag update returned 202. Propagating to instances.
maria (sre): rolling one limiter pod to pick up change. kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/limiter --selector=zone=eu-west-1
derek (platform): while that's rolling, config-service 502 trace: upstream nginx 504 from redis lookup. Looks like Redis auth token expired; config-service failing to fetch latest tenant maps.
lee (oncall): good catch. who owns config-service?
derek (platform): that's infra-team; tagging @maria for help with redis creds.
maria (sre): I have access. rotating creds and restarting config-service.
sam (support): pinging affected accounts with status update: "We're investigating intermittent rate-limiting; mitigations in progress. We'll follow up."
pagerduty-bot: lee acknowledged at 10:18UTC. If no ack from escalation path within 12 minutes, PD will auto-escalate.
ops-bot: limiter rollout completed for 1 pod. health checks green.
lee (oncall): monitoring 429s...
maria (sre): 429s dropped to baseline in eu-west-1 after permissive flip and pod restart. global 429 rate down to ~0.6% from 5%.
derek (platform): config-service restarted and now syncing tenant maps. redis token rotated, sync success at 10:26UTC.
lee (oncall): ok let's re-enable tenant enforcement gradually. follow runbook: re-enable for low-traffic tenants first.
maria (sre): re-enabling staged flags: 
```
# enable enforcement for staging and low-traffic tenants
POST /admin/flags/limiter/enforcement
{"tenants":["staging-*","low-*"], "enforce":true}
```
lee (oncall): applied staged enforcement. observing for 2m.
sam (support): customers updated: "We've applied a temporary mitigation; per-tenant enforcement will be restored gradually. If you still see throttling, please reply to this thread."
ops-bot: PD note appended: "permissive mode flipped; config-service restarted; redis creds rotated; staged enforcement re-enable in progress."
maria (sre): re-enabled enforcement for higher-traffic tenants at 10:34UTC. no spike in 429s observed.
derek (platform): root cause: config-service failed to fetch tenant maps after Redis auth expired -> config-sync returned 502 -> limiter served stale/no policy -> defaulted to hard 429 behavior for unknown tenants. mitigation implemented: rotated token, added health check to config-service, added alert for Redis auth expiry.
lee (oncall): labeling incident: "INC-98765 - config-sync auth expiry -> ratecap misapplied -> temporary permissive fallback". starting post-incident writeup and timeline.
sam (support): filed customer follow-up template in support queue.
maria (sre): adding runbook updates: ensure permissive-flip is automated for config-sync failures; add automated retry/backoff for config-service auth.
lee (oncall): closing PD incident (marked resolved) at 10:53UTC after stable metrics for 20m. leaving this thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-98765 resolved by lee at 10:53UTC.
